This is a collection of all of the stuff Tori-hime (Torii-hime?) aka Kokuu Rikishi posted on Fanbox, that was still available up to 28-02-2026. Ordered from oldest to newest. This does not include the stuff that was posted there, but was also sold on dlsite/dmm. I think most of it is already on e-hentai? Dunno for sure. Too lazy to check right now, but I might look into it at some point.

I'll note that a bunch of stuff is a result of Skeb requests, but, looking at the artist's skeb, it's pretty clear that there's stuff in there that was NOT posted on Fanbox or Fantia. If it exists on the Internet, then I don't know about it.

Boo to people that commission art and keep it only for themselves. Boo I say!

ANYway, enjoy, you pervs, and if you can, spare the artist some money if you enjoy their stuff. I definitely couldn't afford to keep supporting them.
